job.job_description:
We are looking for a Senior AI/ML Engineer with 68 years of overall experience and strong hands-on expertise in Machine Learning and Generative AI (4–6 years).
This role focuses on building, deploying, and scaling AI solutions, including ML models, LLM-powered applications, and AI agent-based systems."
Key responsibilities & Hands-on experience with:
Can do Model Development (Core Responsibility)
Can build & refine ML models for use cases like anomaly detection, forecasting, classification, and RCA (root cause analysis).
Can perform data exploration, feature engineering, and statistical analysis to improve model accuracy and insights
Can design and evaluate LLM prompts, embeddings, and response quality for GenAI applications (RAG, copilots)
Can work on to build Agents, Multi-agents, Decision Flows
Can build scalable AI systems as GenAI / Engineer
Will Design and Implement data pipelines (ingestion ? preprocessing ? embeddings ? storage)
Will Generate design prompts for: Root cause explanation, Failure reasoning, Contextual insights
Will Develop APIs/microservices (FastAPI, backend services)
Will Handle vector DB setup & performance tuning
Will Integrate with Enterprise tools like QIR systems, model outputs, APIs,UI / dashboards
Will Manage data flow between systems



Required Skills & Qualifications



Design, build, and deploy machine learning models and Generative AI solutions, including LLM-based applications, RAG pipelines, and AI agents for real-world use cases.
Develop and optimize end-to-end AI pipelines (data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and deployment).
Implement LLM frameworks (LangChain/LlamaIndex) and integrate with vector databases
Experience building AI Agents / multi-agent systems
LLMs (OpenAI, Llama, Mistral, etc.), LangChain / LlamaIndex,
RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), AI Agents / workflow automation
Vector Databases & Retrieval, Knowledge of embeddings and semantic search
